items.text: Science career coaching is built for a different moment than a specialisation or exam-attempt decision: you already have a rough direction, a research seat, a data or analytics pivot, a biotech-industry role, or a government-exam route, and the real gap is a sequenced plan with real accountability, not another one-time verdict.

The goal is a high-value skill portfolio that compounds instead of a pile of disconnected certificates, the decisions that unlock high income opportunities and moving you toward earlier financial freedom instead of staying one exam cycle away.

Guidance is delivered fully online across India, so weekly accountability keeps going from your hostel, home, or department without depending on how structured your college's own mentoring or placement support happens to be.
